# Procyon Technostructure

> Procyon Technostructure is a Salesforce Consulting Partner and ServiceNow Implementation Partner, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Novato, California, with delivery centers in Toronto, Canada and Chennai, India. 200+ practitioners. ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certified, HIPAA-compliant delivery.

## What Procyon does
- Salesforce consulting, implementation, org health checks and managed services: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Field Service, Revenue Cloud and CPQ, Data Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Health Cloud, Financial Services Cloud, OmniStudio, MuleSoft, Tableau.
- Agentforce implementation, including the Agent Launch Kit (first agents in production in under 4 weeks).
- ServiceNow platform health checks and tech debt removal (8-week remediation), ITSM, ITOM and CMDB, Security Operations, GRC, HR Service Delivery, Customer Service Management, Now Assist and AI agents.
- Data and AI: agentic AI, RAG knowledge assistants, predictive scoring, LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Vertex AI), data governance and MDM.
- Integration and cloud: MuleSoft, SAP and ERP integration, API-first architecture, cloud transformation, application modernization, cybersecurity.
- Salesforce and ServiceNow staff augmentation, dedicated delivery pods, managed services.
- Ranger Fusion: an ERP built natively on Salesforce (sales, accounting, inventory, procurement, projects, HR).

## Industries
Healthcare and life sciences, financial services and insurance, public sector, retail and consumer, communications and media, high tech and SaaS, manufacturing, professional services.
